title: I Can't Wait to Ignore the Main Story of GTA 6, Says Polygon
description: Recent gaming media coverage highlights how GTA 6 side activities like mini-golf, parachuting, and working out might overshadow the main storyline.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Why GTA 6 Side Activities Might Overshadow the Main Story

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the release of Rockstar Games' *GTA 6*, discussions surrounding the title continue to evolve. A recent perspective shared by gaming media outlet Polygon suggests that players might find themselves completely ignoring the main narrative in favor of the game's diverse side activities.

### Beyond Stealing Cars and Police Chases

Traditionally, the core appeal of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise has been deeply rooted in crime, car thefts, and high-stakes police pursuits. These elements form the backbone of the series' dramatic storytelling. However, attention is increasingly shifting toward the micro-experiences scattered across the open world.

According to media discussions, engaging in side activities such as mini-golf, parachuting, and working out sounds remarkably entertaining. For many open-world veterans, these leisure activities offer a compelling alternative to the high-pressure environment of main story missions, allowing players to simply exist and play within the virtual sandbox.

### The Allure of Open-World Distractions

Modern open-world design thrives on environmental immersion and secondary content. When a game world is packed with varied interactive pursuits, getting sidetracked is not a distraction—it is often the primary reason players fall in love with the title. Whether players choose to focus on the narrative arc or spend dozens of hours engaging in side content, the flexibility of the experience remains one of the most anticipated aspects of *GTA 6*.

## Editor's Take

Part of the magic of a *Grand Theft Auto* game is the freedom to completely abandon the main plotline. If activities like working out and playing mini-golf prove as engaging as early discussions suggest, many players might spend their first dozens of hours in Leonida without ever touching a core story mission.
